Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

g=[[0,0,5,3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,0,3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,0,3,0,5,0,3,5,0,0],[3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3],[0,0,0,3,0,0,0,3,0,5,0],[0,0,0,3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,5,3,0,5,0,3,5,0,0],[3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3],[0,5,0,3,0,0,5,3,0,0,0],[0,0,0,3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,0,3,0,0,0,3,0,5,5]]
R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
hsep=[r for r in range(R) if all(c==3 for c in g[r])]
vsep=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(R))]
print(hsep,vsep)
rows=[r for r in range(R) if r not in hsep]; cols=[c for c in range(C) if c not in vsep]
# group contiguous
import itertools
def group(a):
    return [list(gr) for k,gr in itertools.groupby(enumerate(a),lambda t:t[1]-t[0])]
rg=group(rows); cg=group(cols)
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
print(cnt)
out=[]
for rb in rg:
    row=[]
    for cb in cg:
        n=sum(1 for r in [x for _,x in rb] for c in [x for _,x in cb] if g[r][c]==5)
        row.append(n)
    out.append(row)
print(out)
bg=0
res=[[1 if n==2 else bg for n in row] for row in out]
print(res)
